body.name: Normalized FOBI row lift
body.construction: From \(X^{(m)}\), compute \(\overline X_m=m^{-1}\sum_jX_j\) and \(\widehat\Sigma_m=m^{-1}\sum_j(X_j-\overline X_m)(X_j-\overline X_m)^{\mathsf T}\). On \(\{\widehat\Sigma_m\succ0\}\), set \(Z_{m,j}=\widehat\Sigma_m^{-1/2}(X_j-\overline X_m)\), \(\widehat F_m=m^{-1}\sum_j\|Z_{m,j}\|_2^2Z_{m,j}Z_{m,j}^{\mathsf T}\), \(\widehat A_m^{\mathrm F}=\widehat O_m^{\mathsf T}\widehat\Sigma_m^{-1/2}\), and \(\widehat U_m=\ell(\widehat A_m^{\mathrm F})\), where \(\widehat O_m\) is the measurably ordered orthonormal eigenbasis of \(\widehat F_m\). On the complement set \(\widehat U_m=I_q\).
